tactic: intro y hy f₁ induction f₁ with | zero => intro x h₁; exact absurd h₁ (Nat.not_succ_le_zero x) | succ f ih => intro x h₁ f₂ h₂ cases f₂ with | zero => exact absurd h₂ (Nat.not_succ_le_zero x) | succ g => rw [Nat.modCore.go.eq_1, Nat.modCore.go.eq_1] by_cases h : y ≤ x · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h]; exact ih (x - y) _ g _ · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h]
